messages:
Liam (Support): FYI customer BetaHealth opened a severity-2 — their latency dashboard tenant view has no p95/p99 lines after last night's observability pipeline rollout. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/d/obs/tenant/BetaHealth?panel=latency They report SLO alerts firing. Can SRE take a look?

Priya (eng-sre): ACK. Can you paste org id + exact dashboard link and a screenshot? Is this only the tenant-scoped panel or org/global too?

Liam (Support): Org id 10042. Screenshot: https://s3.redwood.ai/bugs/236789-snap.png Customer says org-level shows curves but tenant-level is blank (so p50 still visible on org view).

metrics-bot: [ingest-pipeline] ERROR at 2026-03-16T03:02:10Z - transform label-mapping dropped 2.1M samples for key "tenant" during "rename_tenant_to_org" rollout.

Diego (metrics-infra): We rolled a label-transform that renames tenant->org to unify ingestion. Looks like we didn't emit a compatibility "tenant" alias for older dashboards. That would cause tenant-filtered panels to get no series. I'm looking at the transform commit now.

Casey (Support Ops): Repro steps for support: 1) Console > Observability > Tenant View > select BetaHealth 2) Open "Latency by route" panel 3) Set timeframe last 1h — observe empty p95/p99 lines. Org-wide view: same panel shows curves.

Sam (Platform): Short mitigation: update panel query to OR on labels: e.g. replace filter tenant=10042 with (tenant=10042 OR org=10042) or remove tenant filter to use org-scoped series. That should show percentiles immediately.

Priya (eng-sre): I'll push a hotfix to the transform to emit both labels (tenant + org) for 30d. Pushing now, will monitor ingestion.

Diego (metrics-infra): Confirmed: hotfix queued, applying compatibility mapping at 03:38Z. Note: historical samples where tenant label was already dropped will need backfill. Scheduling backfill job (ETA ~45m).

Liam (Support): Told customer we have a hotfix and backfill scheduled. They asked for ETA and whether alerts will stop firing.

Sam (Platform): As stopgap for alerts, create a temporary alert rule that targets org label as well. Quick rule: query percentile by org id.

Casey (Support Ops): Ran raw series check via API at 03:50Z: curl -s "https://api.redwood.ai/metrics/query?org=10042&metric=latency_ms&agg=percentile(95)&from=-60m" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" Output: {"series":[],"scope":"tenant"} vs org query returns series. So indeed tenant-scoped samples missing.

Diego (metrics-infra): Backfill job started at 03:55Z. It will replay retained raw shards and re-emit tenant label samples. Cost estimate ~ +0.6 GPU-hours. If BetaHealth wants a manual expedited regen we can prioritize.

Priya (eng-sre): Hotfix is live at 03:40Z and verified on canary ingestion. New samples show both labels going forward. Monitoring ingestion for duplicates.

Liam (Support): Customer tried refreshing dashboard at 04:05Z; still blank for p95/p99 in tenant view. I've asked them to hard-refresh and confirm after 30m.

Diego (metrics-infra): Backfill progress: 30% at 04:10Z. ETA ~30-40m. Once backfill completes tenant panels should repopulate historic percentiles.

Priya (eng-sre): After backfill completes, we will send an archive event to the dashboard cache to invalidate older empty-series artifacts. Doing that at completion.

Casey (Support Ops): Pulled updated check at 04:45Z — tenant dashboard now shows p95 line from 03:42 onwards but gaps remain before that. I told customer that recent percentiles are returning as backfill finishes.

Sam (Platform): Note for post-mortem: rollout checklist missing label-compatibility smoke tests for tenant-scoped dashboards. Adding to rollout playbook.

Diego (metrics-infra): Backfill finished at 04:35Z. I manually triggered cache invalidation and reindex for tenant=10042 at 04:38Z.

Priya (eng-sre): I can confirm p95/p99 lines reappeared in BetaHealth tenant view at ~04:40Z. Monitoring for any dupes or incorrect aggregates.

Liam (Support): Customer confirm: BetaHealth says graphs are back and alerts quieted. They appreciated the quick turnaround. :relieved:

Casey (Support Ops): Closing escalation — root cause: label-mapping transform removed legacy "tenant" label during pipeline rollout. Remediation: hotfix to emit both labels + backfill + cache invalidation. Action items: add rollout smoke test, notify customers with custom tenant dashboards, and run a sweep for other tenants.

Priya (eng-sre): Adding incident note and assigning post-mortem to Diego + Sam. Will include timeline and cost impact.

Diego (metrics-infra): FYI I'll create a one-off alert for any tenant->org mapping drops during rollouts.

Liam (Support): Thanks team — closing thread and emailing BetaHealth post-mortem summary.
